ZWE.note: Training is for visually impaired people, not civil servants.

facts.fact: POTRAZ's director general said its digital skills programme for visually impaired people, begun in 2023, had trained 549 participants across the country, including 48 at a Masvingo workshop.
facts.system: POTRAZ digital skills training for persons with disabilities

systems.system: POTRAZ digital skills training for persons with disabilities

facts.fact: POTRAZ's director general said it had donated 567 computers to disability-focused institutions, with adaptive software for the visually impaired and audio equipment for those with hearing impairments.
facts.system: POTRAZ computer donations to disability institutions
